page_title: MAI 0-1 RBL | Mainz v RB Leipzig 13/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Sven Jablonski has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes it short.
90+3' Referee Sven Jablonski has finally had enough of Bo Henriksen and brandishes a yellow card at him!
90+3' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Romulo Cardoso is replaced by Assan Ouedraogo (RB Leipzig).
90+3' Substitution. Christoph Baumgartner walks off the pitch and Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) comes on as a substitute.
90+2' PENALTY APPEAL by Mainz, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' A dangerous looking corner kick from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is cleared to safety by the defence.
86' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
84' The current number of shots on goal is 2:4.
83' Nelson Weiper (Mainz) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
81' RB Leipzig have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
75' It will be a substitution. Silvan Widmer (Mainz) is ready to enter the pitch as Anthony Caci walks off.
75' Bo Henriksen decides to make a substitution. Arnaud Nordin will be replaced by Sota Kawasaki (Mainz).
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Phillipp Mwene trots off the pitch and is replaced by Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz).
73' Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) tested Robin Zentner with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
71' Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the right post.
69' The Mainz players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
66' The substitution is prepared. Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Antonio Nusa.
66' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) replacing Johan Bakayoko.
65' Substitution. William Boving leaves the pitch and is replaced by Armindo Sieb (Mainz).
62' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just wide of the right post.
59' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Mainz, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
57' The total number of attempts is 10:15.
55' One of the players from RB Leipzig times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
52' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
52' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
49' Great teamplay by Mainz as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Sven Jablonski no option but to blow his whistle.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' RB Leipzig take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' RB Leipzig can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
43' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
42' The ball falls kindly for Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just wide of the right post.

40' 0 - 1 Goal! Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Robin Zentner had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:1.
38' Total attempts – 8:9.
34' Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
32' Problems for Ole Werner as Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Ezechiel Banzuzi replaces him.
30' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
28' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Mainz, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
28' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) commits a rough challenge and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for an infringement.
27' Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
26' Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
25' Arnaud Nordin (Mainz) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
24' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
22' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) will deliver the corner kick.
21' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is penalised for holding. Sven Jablonski signals a set piece.
18' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) misses a golden opportunity after his strike hits the post!
15' Substitution. Stefan Bell (Mainz) is replaced by Andreas Hanche-Olsen.
14' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Mainz is cautioned for aggressive play.
14' Nelson Weiper (Mainz) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Peter Gulacsi is alert and denies him.
13' Arnaud Nordin (Mainz) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
12' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.

9' OFF THE POST! Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the right post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
7' Stefan Bell (Mainz) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
6' Sven Jablonski interrupts the game. One of the players from RB Leipzig won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
4' Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) latches onto a cross and drills a shot towards goal that goes well wide of the right post.
3' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Mainz was in an offside position.
1' The first half has started.
RB Leipzig will kick the game off.
Sven Jablonski got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
